text: The live archer AI firing rule and the global projectile gravity constant are both held, closing the ledger's 'arrow arc physics' item outright. Projectile.GRAVITY = 3 (px/frame^2), applied as velY += GRAVITY every update. EnemyArcher.fireArrow() fires from (mcs.x, mcs.y-60) at a target sampled at (target.mcs.x, target.mcs.y-60), solving a fixed-45-degree-ish ballistic: velA = sqrt(GRAVITY*|dx|/0.866), velXa = velA*0.866, t = |dx|/velXa, velYa = (dy - 0.5*GRAVITY*t*t)/t, sign-flipped when firing left, then a uniform aim jitter velYa += Math.random()*8 - 4. Above level 50 a coin flip sets Damage.LAUNCH_KNOCKDOWN on the arrow. EnemyGoblinThrower uses the identical solve; EnemyKanjiGuardian divides by 0.866/3 for a flatter arc.
